request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Change only one thing: erase the pointed horn that sticks out of the left side of the head, so the head is a smooth round chrome dome. Do not redraw anything else: keep the two hot magenta eye lenses, the big hot magenta ray cannon, the antenna, the armoured legs, the size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
